# MoComposer

The phone composer: action chips, then + for attach, model and effort, the field, and mic, send or stop.

`OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.MoComposer` · 14 Phone

## Use

```jsx
<OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.MoComposer>…</OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.MoComposer>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.MoComposer">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

Composer pinned above the keyboard: action chips, then + (attach, model, effort), the field, and mic until there is text, then send. Stop replaces mic while a turn runs and the box is empty. Placeholder names who you talk to. @startingPoint section="Phone" subtitle="Composer: done, running, typing" viewport="860x380"
